helpers.description: Install the packaged Host Bridge CLI and optionally link its well-known profile.

optionDescriptions.--source-root: Profile root containing packaged platform binaries.
optionDescriptions.--install-dir: Target binary directory; defaults to the platform user bin directory.
optionDescriptions.--link-well-known-profile: Link the Hermes well-known Host Bridge profile.
optionDescriptions.--no-link-well-known-profile: Install only the binary without a profile link.
optionDescriptions.--host-home: Host user home used to locate the well-known profile.
optionDescriptions.--host-profile: Explicit Host Bridge profile JSON path.
optionDescriptions.--force-profile-link: Replace an existing Hermes well-known profile path.

commands.result: Installed executable path and profile-link status.
effects: may create a well-known profile link

helpers.description: Maintain and query the resident bounded library, workflow, and run index.

optionDescriptions.--db: SQLite database path for the resident projection.
optionDescriptions.--limit: Bound the requested or returned item count.
optionDescriptions.--library-id: Restrict refresh to one Zotero library id.
optionDescriptions.--collection-id: Restrict refresh to one collection id.
optionDescriptions.--collection-key: Restrict refresh to one collection key.
optionDescriptions.--tag: Restrict refresh to one exact tag.
optionDescriptions.--item-type: Restrict refresh to one Zotero item type.
optionDescriptions.--query: Apply an optional bounded library text query.
optionDescriptions.--run-id: Register this Host-owned workflow run id.
optionDescriptions.--workflow-id: Associate the registered run with this workflow id.
optionDescriptions.--state: Set the initial registered run state.
optionDescriptions.--payload: Read optional initial status JSON inline, from a path, or from @file.

helpers.description: Synchronize and query the resident bounded notification projection.

optionDescriptions.--db: SQLite database path for the resident projection.
optionDescriptions.--limit: Bound the number of notification events.
optionDescriptions.--report-empty: Emit structured JSON instead of the silent sentinel when nothing changed.
optionDescriptions.--event: Acknowledge this explicit event id locally; repeat for more ids.

helpers.description: Plan and launch bounded workflow submissions with independent workflow and provider validation.

optionDescriptions.--db: SQLite database path for resident planning state.
optionDescriptions.--items: Read explicit item refs as inline JSON, a path, or @file.
optionDescriptions.--workflow: Select or annotate the workflow id.
optionDescriptions.--check: Choose the readiness gap to query.
optionDescriptions.--input: Read readiness query JSON inline, from a path, or @file.
optionDescriptions.--batch-size: Bound parent refs in each planned batch.
optionDescriptions.--mode: Choose Host-owned submit or agent-owned handoff.
optionDescriptions.--none: Use an explicit no-selection workflow input.
optionDescriptions.--workflow-options: Read workflow-owned options inline, from a path, or @file.
optionDescriptions.--provider-profile: Read a workflow-independent backend profile inline, from a path, or @file.
optionDescriptions.--plan: Read the validated plan produced by this helper.
optionDescriptions.--concurrency: Bound the number of plan entries launched now.
optionDescriptions.--confirm-concurrency: Confirm an explicitly requested concurrency greater than one.
optionDescriptions.--output-dir: Write agent-run handoff downloads to this directory.

commands.result: Host-owned run or agent-run handoff handles.
effects: launches only the bounded plan entries
